reviews.text: A very welcoming and organized practice. I wanted to thank everyone for their professionalism and helpfulness towards our cat. I especially want to mention Rosaria at reception, who, both on the phone and in person, always welcomes us with kindness, helpfulness, and above all, with a smile, which in these situations is no small thing. Sergio.

Terrible experience today: disorganization and a complete lack of empathy from the doctor on duty.
I want to point out that in the past, with other veterinarians at the facility, I've experienced extreme professionalism. Unfortunately, today's experience with the doctor on duty was terrible. We went to the clinic regarding our cat's ear problem. Over the phone, we specifically asked if it was possible to send a high-resolution photo in advance to assess whether moving was really necessary, but we were told we needed to bring her in for a same-day visit.
Once there: Long wait - We had to wait a long time only to find that the doctor didn't even take the cat out of the carrier.

Total inconsistency: In the end, she looked directly at the photo (something she'd refused to do on the phone) and dismissed us by telling us to come back the next day because the cytology specialist wasn't there. A completely avoidable trip and stress for the animal.

Lack of professionalism: The doctor was extremely rude and indifferent to me. It's a shame this was the way things were handled, because the other doctors had always proven to be excellent. Today, unfortunately, it just caused unnecessary stress for the cat.
I am Mr. ROSANO, they are very helpful and understanding people and maximum availability and professionalism.

Experience and professionalism distinguish them... I brought my dog ​​for sterilization and after an hour I was home... thanks to everyone and especially to Dr. Palumbo who, in addition to being professional, has a big heart.. thank youuuuu....

I've been here and still go to the center for my cat, who broke her leg two weeks ago. I truly appreciate the professionalism and kindness of the staff, who are highly trained, kind, and helpful. A special thanks goes to the receptionist, Rosaria, who does her job impeccably, and to Dr. Palumbo, an excellent veterinarian and a wonderful person. I thank them again for everything they do for our furry four-legged friends.
I entrusted my cats to Dr. Palumbo, who saved them for me. The entire staff is highly professional and shows great love for animals.

Sos vet is not just a veterinary clinic, it is a place where your four-legged friends will be cared for, loved and pampered by everyone from the doctors to all the staff, not to forget the friendly secretary Rosaria who always welcomes you with a smile and the sweet Melina, the clinic's mascot 🤗🐕💗 …
Professionalism and availability in this clinic you will find everything for your 4-legged friend, from the doctors to all the staff including the little Melina mascot of the clinic
I must compliment them on their precision, even in issuing prescriptions.

I took my dog ​​two years ago for over a month because I saw him getting thinner and thinner and they, with the excuse of tests and tests that had nothing to do with it, ate up all the money they could get... on January 1, 2023, the dog had a hemorrhage and we brought him back. They said let's start a wash. We'll do more tests to see if he has mosquito disease and then sand disease. I said my dog ​​has never been to the beach so they wanted more money. My dog, as in the first photo taken, couldn't even stand up there so I decided to take him and take him elsewhere where they told us he had arrived alive by a miracle... After seeing the dog at the new clinic and having an ultrasound, they discovered that he had an infection that had damaged other internal organs and they gave us the treatment and here is our dog after the right treatment! I showed you the before and after! In my opinion, they are inexperienced and only attached to the God of money.

This morning we went to the clinic with our cat for an emergency. Dr. Anna greeted us and immediately struck us as a highly skilled physician, both humanely and otherwise. She immediately provided first aid to Batuffolo, a Siberian cat of about 10 years old, performing a deep surgical procedure to remove a significant abscess. After about an hour, we all went home. Thank you, Dr. Anna, for your kindness and professionalism. You've given us peace of mind seeing our cat doing better.
Attachment to money only and exclusively

Impeccable surgery and a rapid recovery!
I took my Trilly for spaying and was truly impressed by the professionalism and care with which everything was handled. The surgery went very well...she woke up immediately afterwards, calm and alert, as if nothing had happened.
The wound was very small, almost invisible, and she showed no signs of pain or discomfort. She was able to go home immediately, and her recovery was rapid, without complications.
The post-op care was handled with great care: the staff is always available to answer any questions, with timely checkups and clear instructions.
A truly cutting-edge clinic, where you can sense the love and expertise for animals. I recommend it without hesitation!

I brought my dog ​​to the Sos Vet Veterinary Clinic after a sudden illness, and I can only speak with great gratitude. From the first phone call, the staff was kind, helpful, and very professional.
As soon as we arrived, we were greeted in a clean, tidy, and reassuring environment. The vets were extremely competent and attentive, taking the time to explain everything to me clearly and humanely. They treated my four-legged friend with great kindness, immediately putting him at ease.
The diagnosis was quick and accurate, and the treatment brought improvements within just a few hours. Furthermore, I really appreciated the transparency of costs and the willingness to answer all my questions, even after the visit.
I highly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for a serious, loving, and highly qualified team. It's rare to find a place where the passion for animals is so strong. Thank you so much!

I'm thankful I found this clinic: here, love for animals, expertise, and professionalism are at home.
They welcomed me and my furry friend at a time when, elsewhere, all seemed lost.
They gave me hope again, discovering a serious hormonal problem that no other vet had been able to identify.
Thank you so much for what you did for my little one. 💓

Stay away! Initially, they quoted me a price of €170 (X-ray + blood test), which would have cost €300 if I'd paid by card. I should report them. They're also incompetent because, after all this money, they couldn't tell me what was wrong with my dog. Terrible.
Always available, welcoming, and passionate about their work! Everything was perfect.
According to their website they should also deal with exotics in emergency, but alas it seems that's just to show off.

Dr. M.P. is very venal and arrogant, as is her secretary. I had an experience last year. I took my furry friend for an operation. I wanted to pay by debit card, but she told me that if I wanted to deduct the money, it would cost 1,250.00, while under the table it would cost 650.00. Obviously, I went to withdraw the money to pay in cash.
I couldn't deduct the expenses, while they pocketed 650.00 plus blood tests paid for three times under the table, for a total of 800.00.
I strongly advise against it. Trust doctors who love animals and not for business.
Structure with excellent veterinarians, especially Dr. Manuela is always available and very good and human, I am happy to be her client highly recommended
Congratulations! I found the people and doctors to be truly knowledgeable and helpful! I came across this facility purely by chance! I highly recommend this clinic to all pet lovers!
Structure that saved me one Sunday morning when my vet wasn't answering the phone, they welcomed me with love, kindness, thank you so much ❤️ 🫶 …

I went to the SoS Vet Veterinary Clinic a few days ago to have my new four-legged friend microchipped.
The staff was fantastic! They welcomed us with kindness and gentleness!
The doctor was excellent!

I highly recommend this clinic, not only for the above, but above all for their professionalism and precision!
A truly excellent clinic!

Tests run for two months with incorrect results. I also had another stool test done on the same day at another clinic, and the results were different; obviously, theirs were incorrect. I went to them, telling them that my dog ​​(I emphasize …
Professionalism and kindness. My dog ​​really appreciates it 😊. …
I recommend her. We arrived from Milan with our dog who wasn't feeling well. The doctor is professional and knowledgeable. Thank you very much.
